method_notes: All candidates scored at pinned shas; impl-20 was judged 4 times as it was polished (52885564 -> 800a4fe8 -> 86f5ffbc -> 95fa4718 -> d312263a) and only the final stable sha is scored. impl-24 and impl-21 were still churning at close; their last-measured shas are recorded in candidates[].
The V6c CRLF-truncated probe (my early impl-24 finding) was withdrawn: the fixture was rewritten mid-round and that boundary is explicitly informational, not judged.

must_not_be / accept semantics are class-level: NOT-SAFE(vault-absent) is rejected while NOT-VERIFIED(vault-absent) passes; reason aliases (hash/sha/digest, absent/missing, bare-vs-suffixed) are normalized.
Peer vrun/vreview/vadv JSONs measured against older mid-write shas were not scored; I re-ran runner-40 and vadv54 myself at pinned shas.
No false-SAFE was accepted anywhere in the final table: every SAFE/VERIFIED row was cross-checked against my independent reference and the filesystem ground truth.
